items.rule: Goal of the game: be the first player to have no dice left.
Each player receives 4 dice and 3 cards at the start.
The undealt cards are placed face down in the centre of the table to form the draw pile.
Each player rolls their dice; the player who gets the most Wazabi (W) figures starts.
On their turn, a player rolls all of their dice, then draws cards, gives dice away, and may play one card.
Draw as many cards as the number of card-draw figures obtained on the dice.
Give each die showing the give-die figure to the player of your choice.
A player may play only one card per turn, and playing a card is optional.
To play a card, the player must have rolled at least as many W figures as shown at the top left of the card (minimum figures); 'Aucune' means the card can be played even with no W figure.
A played card's effect applies immediately.
Played or discarded cards are placed face up next to the draw pile.
When the draw pile is empty, the face-up played cards are shuffled and turned over to form a new draw pile.
If there are no cards in the draw pile, a player who must draw takes a card from the hand of an opponent of their choice, who presents their cards fanned out face down.
Card (cost 1 W): remove 1 of your dice from the game; cannot be played if you rolled 2 or more give-die figures that turn.
Card (cost 2 W): all players, including the player of the card, give all their dice to their left or right neighbour, direction chosen by the player who plays the card.
Card (cost 3 W): remove 2 of your dice from the game.
Card (cost 3 W): give 1 of your dice to the player of your choice, independent of any dice already given through rolled figures.
Card (cost 1 W): take 1 card of your choice from the face-down fanned hand of a player of your choice; if no player has cards, take one from the draw pile.
Card (cost 1 W): the player of your choice keeps only 1 card; the chosen player must have at least 2 cards, picks the one to keep and discards the others.
Card (cost 1 W): draw 3 cards from the draw pile, independent of cards drawn through rolled figures.
Card (cost 2 W): all players except you keep only 2 cards; players with more choose which to keep and discard the rest.

Card (no cost): the player of your choice skips their turn; place it face up in front of the chosen player, who keeps it until they have skipped a turn then discards it; several such cards can stack in front of the same player.
Card (no cost): play again and reverse the direction of play.
The game ends as soon as a player has no dice left.
The first player with no dice left wins the game.
Optionally, play can continue until only one loser remains.
The base game has no point scoring; victory is determined only by getting rid of all dice.
Team variant for 4 or 6 players: play in teams of 2; the first player with no dice left makes their team win.
Game length variant: lengthen or shorten the game by increasing or decreasing the number of dice dealt at the start.
Tournament variant: fix a number of games; the winner of each game scores 1 point per die remaining among all opponents; after the planned games, the player or team with the most points wins.
